corrections_2026_11_03.R-01_codeword_tables: Corrected: the serialized ASH-Model (one-based x1..x9, x8 = 0 in all 16 codewords) and APS (zero-based b0..b8, b8 = 0 in all 16) tables are NOT identical; raw intersection is 8 of 16 members. Swapping the final two coordinates of every ASH codeword makes the sets exactly equal (example: ASH 000011101 -> APS 000011110). The permutation is an involution on all 512 states and commutes with XOR for all 512 x 16 state/codeword pairs. Both sets are closed 16-member doubly-even [9,4,4] codes (min nonzero weight 4, 32 sixteen-state orbits in the full 512-state space). Affected text corrected in rows identity.ash_state, identity.closure_orbit_class, verification cases VC-PROP-04/VC-PROP-05, and in source-to-output-map.md / findings-and-next-change.md F-01 (restated).
corrections_2026_11_03.R-02_state_space_scope: Corrected framing: ASH-Model sections 2-3 distinguish the full universe V = F2^9 (512 states) from the image/video application's integrity subset E (256 states); states outside E remain valid F2^9 vertices. The APS R1 all-first-class-coordinate model is a domain-level statement over the common nine-coordinate universe, not a same-domain contradiction with E. The image/video parity policy is not automatically the personal-profile mapping, and the reference algebra/data/branch computations are not discarded.
corrections_2026_11_03.R-03_topology_vs_rendering: Corrected: the depth-4 semantic branch tree (121 nodes, 81 leaves, all 16 messages reached) and the independent rendering grammar F -> FF[+F]F[-F] (625 forward symbols at depth 4) are separate objects in the ASH source; the earlier conflation in findings F-11 is corrected.
